{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Acid''' was a generally corrosive substance that could be found in many forms, such as [[Acid rain/Legends|acid rain]].<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], there were rivers of acid.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Speciality [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] [[Slug/Legends|ammunition]] could be loaded with acid, which would be released upon impact with a target.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> A plant known as an [[Acid Plant]] found on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] shot out a gland-like acid onto anyone who wandered under it.<ref name="SEMP">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> The Desert of Salma on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] was a land of acid pools and dry lakes.<ref name="Caravan">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>
